title: Empennage — Fin Box Ribs 4 to 9 — Replacement by Pocketed Rib Set

issue.reason: Initial issue of the optional pocketed rib set replacement bulletin.

abstract: Optional replacement of the fin box ribs between ribs 4 and 9 by the pocketed set, offered only to operators who already have the fin box open for a repair, because the weight saving alone cannot justify the downtime.

sections.planning_reason: The fatigue test read-across showed the fin box rib webs between ribs 4 and 9 carrying reserve factors well above the design target, and the pocketed rib set introduced in production takes 11.4 kg out of the empennage. There is no in-service problem and no safety content. This bulletin exists so that an operator whose fin box is already open for a repair or for a lightning strike inspection can take the weight saving without a second entry, and it is deliberately written as an optional bulletin.
sections.description: The six ribs between rib 4 and rib 9 are replaced by pocketed items of the same external geometry. The rib caps, the rib feet, the shear ties and the attachment fittings at rib 1 are unchanged, and the fin skin panels are not touched.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Get access to the fin box interior through the fin leading edge access panels in zones 321 and 324. Support the fin box with the internal cradle before any rib is removed and do not remove more than two adjacent ribs at one time. Remove the screws AES932279K1 and the rib D5530116876335 at each position in the order given in the accomplishment instructions. Do a detailed visual inspection of the rib foot land and of the shear tie D5530114423837 at each position. Install the pocketed rib and re-use the screws at the original pitch, torqued to the value in the accomplishment instructions. Repeat for the remaining rib positions. Do a fin box internal inspection to the standard task and record the web thickness reference dimension. Install the access panels. Update the aircraft weight and balance record with the mass change. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-13 aircraft MSN C00001 through C00717 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00721 onward carry the pocketed set. A partial rib set is not permitted: all six ribs must be replaced together.
sections.material_note: Kit K5530-1004-01 contains the six pocketed ribs and the internal cradle hire. Lead time is forty-six weeks and the kit is built to order. Removed ribs are returned to Aeralis for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's discretion, only when the fin box is already open for another task.

title: Empennage — Fin Box Ribs 4 to 9 — Replacement by Pocketed Rib Set

issue.reason: Effectivity re-stated to exclude ribs carrying a blend repair, with a records check the operator can run before the kit is ordered.

abstract: Optional replacement of the fin box ribs between ribs 4 and 9 by the pocketed set, offered to operators who already have the fin box open, and closed to any rib carrying a blend repair at a pocket boundary.

sections.planning_reason: The fatigue test read-across showed the fin box rib webs between ribs 4 and 9 carrying reserve factors well above the design target, and the pocketed rib set introduced in production takes 11.4 kg out of the empennage. There is no in-service problem and no safety content. This bulletin exists so that an operator whose fin box is already open for a repair or for a lightning strike inspection can take the weight saving without a second entry, and it is deliberately written as an optional bulletin.
sections.description: The six ribs between rib 4 and rib 9 are replaced by pocketed items of the same external geometry. The rib caps, the rib feet, the shear ties and the attachment fittings at rib 1 are unchanged, and the fin skin panels are not touched.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Run the eligibility check against the aircraft structural record and confirm that no rib between rib 4 and rib 9 carries a blend repair at or within 25 mm of a pocket boundary. Get access to the fin box interior through the fin leading edge access panels in zones 321 and 324. Support the fin box with the internal cradle before any rib is removed and do not remove more than two adjacent ribs at one time. Remove the screws AES932279K1 and the rib D5530116876335 at each position in the order given in the accomplishment instructions. Do a detailed visual inspection of the rib foot land and of the shear tie D5530114423837 at each position, and confirm against the structural record that no blend repair has been missed. Install the pocketed rib and re-use the screws at the original pitch, torqued to the value in the accomplishment instructions. Repeat for the remaining rib positions. Do a fin box internal inspection to the standard task and record the web thickness reference dimension against the pocketed column. Install the access panels. Update the aircraft weight and balance record with the mass change. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CIRRANE-13 aircraft MSN C00001 through C00717 that are pre modification standard. Aircraft delivered from MSN C00721 onward carry the pocketed set. A partial rib set is not permitted: all six ribs must be replaced together. A rib carrying a blend repair to SRM-C-55-30-11-907 at or within 25 mm of a pocket boundary position is excluded, and because the set has to be complete, one such rib takes the whole aircraft out of the effectivity until that rib has been replaced by a solid item.
sections.material_note: Kit K5530-1004-01 contains the six pocketed ribs and the internal cradle hire. Lead time is forty-six weeks and the kit is built to order. Before the kit is ordered, run the eligibility check in the accomplishment instructions against the aircraft structural record: list every blend repair recorded on ribs 4 to 9, take its recorded position from the repair report and compare it with the pocket boundary table on sheet 2 of the accomplishment drawing. The check takes an hour at a desk and is the only way to avoid a forty-six week kit arriving for an aircraft that cannot take it. Removed ribs are returned to Aeralis for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's discretion, only when the fin box is already open for another task and only where the eligibility check on the rib repair history has passed.

revision_history.reason: Repaired ribs excluded from the effectivity; pre-order eligibility check against the structural record added to the accomplishment instructions and the material information
